title: Chapter 1427 - 7: Is That The 'Galaxy'? (Part 3)

Chapter 1427 - 7: Is That The 'Galaxy'? (Part 3)

Chapter 1427 - 7: Is That the 'Galaxy'? (Part 3)

"Collect."

Lin Yuan directly took away the Seven God Tree, then transformed into a ray of primordial light, once again breaking through the blockade of numerous Time Lords.

In just an instant, Lin Yuan's presence vanished from the perception range of all the Time Lords.

"Who was that?"

The second-level Time Lords, who had been confronting each other, were somewhat perplexed. They were just about to take action, only to find the Seven God Tree gone?

"Such terrifying power!"

"Forget it, let's not chase."

The second-level peak Lords in confrontation, as well as the Lords hidden in the shadows, sighed inwardly with no intention to pursue.

Firstly, the power of the Lord who just took the Seven God Tree was too terrifying. If they hadn't succeeded in taking it, they might have had a chance to fight if they joined forces. But since the Seven God Tree was already taken, there was no need to pursue.

To try to retake the Seven God Tree from such an existence? The hope is too slim.

...

In the distance.

At the same time, there were Time Lords observing the Seven God Tree.

One of the Time Lords had a solemn expression, and behind them stood over ten time lifeforms, including the 'Mother of the Screw Realm', Wan Chengkong.

This solemn-faced Time Lord was Lord Chu Wei, the Time Lord of the area near the Chaos Void. This time, with the opening of the Wanwei space-time, Lord Chu Wei gathered many time lifeforms to scout within the Wanwei space-time.

At this moment, Lord Chu Wei was introducing the Time Lords confronting each other near the Seven God Tree to the time lifeforms behind him.

Lord Chu Wei knew his own strength and had no intention of competing for the Seven God Tree, but since he encountered such a treasure, watching from afar was enough to satisfy his curiosity.

"That is the Black Light Lord, a second-level peak Lord. If you encounter it, you must not offend it."

"That is the Lord of Sky Silver, also a second-level peak Lord. With your strength, you cannot withstand its past time-space erasure."

"That is Lord Qingmu..."

...

Lord Chu Wei introduced to the many time lifeforms behind him these second-level peak Time Lords, who were hard to encounter even once, let alone seven or eight gathered together.

The 'Mother of the Screw Realm', Wan Chengkong, was also listening intently, as information about Lords would be costly even to purchase, so learning from Lord Chu Wei was absolutely a gain.

Just then—

A hazy primordial light flashed from afar, directly penetrating the blockade ring of seven or eight second-level peak Lords, taking the Seven God Tree and disappearing again, transforming into primordial light and flashing away again.

Only after the Seven God Tree disappeared did the seven or eight second-level peak Lords react, but still did not take any action.

"What was that?"

The time lifeforms standing behind Lord Chu Wei were incredulous.

The Seven God Tree just disappeared like that?

Lord Chu Wei also hadn't quite reacted.

It was only a moment later that he spoke with lingering fear: "The existence that just took the Seven God Tree, its power is far more terrifying than other second-level peak Lords. If you encounter it, don't even bother escaping; if it wants to kill you, there's no way to escape."

Lord Chu Wei steadied himself, then said with some shock: "Strange, such an existence, I have never heard of it..."

Lord Chu Wei did not notice the hint of incredulity in the expressions of the two time lifeforms behind him, 'Mother of the Screw Realm', Wan Chengkong.

The level of the primordial light was overpowering, but the faint Taiji aura within it seemed somewhat familiar to the two time lifeforms.

"How does it seem like the Galaxy?"

The Mother of the Screw Realm thought she must have felt it wrong, having sparred with Lin Yuan several times and faced the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

That's how they perceived the similarity between them.

Chaos Void.

An avatar of Lin Yuan was chatting leisurely with the Mother of the Screw Realm, Wan Chengkong.

The three time lifeforms would gather every so often, and they got along quite well.

"Hahaha, Galaxy, we were just in that Wanwei space-time watching the battle over the Seven God Tree, which was ultimately taken by a mysterious powerhouse, whose methods were somewhat similar to yours."

Wan Chengkong looked at Lin Yuan with interest: "Galaxy, did you perhaps gain a legacy left by that one?"

The Mother of the Screw Realm nodded in admiration: "The legacy left by such a powerhouse would be earth-shattering, no wonder you're so powerful, Galaxy... Such an opportunity..."

Wan Chengkong and the Mother of the Screw Realm looked at Lin Yuan with a bit of envy.

Powerful as Lord Chu Wei was, even he revered that mysterious powerhouse. These time lifeforms could only look up in awe.

Of course, Wan Chengkong and the Mother of the Screw Realm were only envious and had no other thoughts, merely sighing at Lin Yuan's incredible fortune.

"Seven God Tree?"

Lin Yuan looked at the two time lifeforms.

Within Wanwei space-time, the timeline couldn't be observed, and causality was suppressed, so he hadn't noticed that the Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong were nearby.

"Yes, who exactly was that mysterious Lord who took the Seven God Tree? Even Lord Chu Wei didn't know their identity." Wan Chengkong was very curious.

The Mother of the Screw Realm also looked at Lin Yuan with curiosity.

"Who?"

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly: "It's nothing mysterious, that was me."

The Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong were both stunned upon hearing this.
